dataNotes: Native ACP integration. MoPilot adds two modes to its own Kilo process (KILO_CONFIG_CONTENT, never written to the user's settings): mopilot-ask, the default, asks before edits, commands and web fetches; mopilot-full runs them without asking. Kilo's own code and debug modes run allowlisted commands and edits without asking. Session sharing is off.
